description: FREE lite email deliverability audit of a domain (bare domain, e.g. example.com). Runs the same 12 SPF/DKIM/DMARC/MX checks as audit_mailauth but returns top-line results only: 0-100 score, A-F grade, spoofing/deliverability risk level, check counts, and the titles of the top gaps — the observed records and per-check evidence are capped. Use this to triage whether a domain needs the full audit_mailauth report, or call audit_mailauth directly for the complete evidence-backed scan.
